sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain unbeaten over their last five matches with four wins and a draw, putting them in a strong position. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and arrive in poor form, having won only once in their last five outings, making this a favorable fixture for the league leaders.
divisionWide: The title race tightens as second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town, offering an opportunity to close the 2-point gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, in third on 19 points, host Eccleshall in what could be a closely contested affair between two in-form sides. Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community in a fixture between nearby rivals in mid-table. Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir in a clash of teams around the 11–17-point range. Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills looking to reverse recent form, while struggling sides Shawbury United (without a win in five) visit Barnton, and Crewe host Allscott Heath. Brereton Social face Widnes Town at home against a side propping up the league, and Cheadle Heath Nomads make the trip to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's lowest-placed teams.
